quarterly_data.quarter: Co-Tech Development annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product role (annual report): Co-Tech developed HVLP4-grade copper foil for AI servers in 2024; its HVLP3/HVLP4 foil (VL/PF series) and A-RTF foil (RG series) go into inner-layer PCBs for high-layer-count AI servers and general servers, with specialised foils for power-layer, outer-layer and HDI PCBs and 4th-generation RG (A-RTF) foil for PCIe Gen 6

quarterly_data.quarter: Co-Tech Development annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (annual report, citing ITRI data as of December 2025): global copper foil market share Mitsui 37%, Furukawa 16%, Co-Tech 10%; HVLP copper foil supply is concentrated in Co-Tech and a few Japanese makers (Mitsui, Furukawa)

quarterly_data.quarter: Co-Tech Development annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (annual report): HVLP4 supply growth lags AI demand owing to long client certification and slow yield ramp; the 2026 supply-demand gap for HVLP4 copper foil is projected at 15% to 25%, and high-end PCB materials are expected to see a 2-to-3 year upward price cycle; new AI server platforms (the B300 and GB30 generations, as printed) accelerate the shift to HVLP4

quarterly_data.quarter: Co-Tech Development annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Long-term plan (annual report): Co-Tech's Plant No. 3 in Yunlin is scheduled to start trial production in the first quarter of 2027 to make high-end HVLP products; Co-Tech and major Japanese makers are increasing capacity between 2025 and 2027
